What I do

Six ways I can
grow your email revenue

01
Full email strategy & campaign management

End-to-end ownership: strategy, copywriting, automation, deliverability monitoring, and performance reporting. Built for businesses that want email to be a proper revenue channel.

02
Lifecycle flow architecture

Welcome series, nurture sequences, win-back flows, pre-call sequences. Logic-mapped, copy-complete, and tested. The funnel runs and converts while you focus on other things.

03
A/B testing & experimentation

Hypothesis-driven testing across subject lines, CTAs, copy angles, objection handling, and send timing. Every test documented, every learning applied.

04
Deliverability recovery & infrastructure

SPF/DKIM/DMARC audit and setup, list hygiene, segmentation strategy. Move from spam and promotions back to the primary inbox and stay there.

05
CRM architecture & segmentation

Build the CRM logic that makes automation actually work: segments, tags, triggers, and scoring systems that surface high-intent leads at exactly the right moment.

06
Acquisition-to-email strategy alignment

Most email strategies ignore what's happening at the top of the funnel. I connect paid acquisition insights, angles, objections, and creative data to email copy and sequence logic.
